scope: Inert Artifact inspection and descriptor lifetime through Oop protocols
retained_checks: Invalid paths, missing/truncated/duplicate descriptions, ABI/target mismatch, missing/escaping native requirements and sparse-file size limit
Real dylib constructor sentinel is never activated by inspection
Nine current String/Integer/Vector/ObjectModel dependencies collect while constructing and reading descriptors
All descriptor fields, list projections and invalid index/arity cases preserve their behavior
Native failure propagates exactly without overwriting language diagnostics
Transient input is released while its descriptor remains rooted; descriptor is reclaimed after final release
Symbol projection preserves its existing C-string rule while String projections retain embedded NUL bytes
Invalid native path bytes reject; ObjectModel clone preserves descriptor references
Authored publication and live descriptor replacement survive repeated module initialization
Compiled source uses the public inspection operation without activation
representation_adjustments: Declared callbacks replace raw native entries
Oop byte values and existing Word/String messages replace native carriers
Reclamation is checked by allocation identity rather than sending messages to freed objects
remaining: Generation ledger image cases and final raw-root rerun remain in flight
Other native/compiler integration and scope decisions
